column1: # Real 49-byte `0x04/0x05` attitude pushes from a Pocket 3 on current firmware, shared by
# both shells (OpenPocketCine#621, reporter capture of 2026-10-31, posted 2026-11-01).
# The bytes are as captured: nothing padded or modified. Pose labels follow the reported
# display pitch, not an external measurement.
# `AttitudeLayoutTest` (Kotlin). Expected values are tenths of a degree, int16 LE:
# native pitch @0, yaw @4, display pitch = -@20. Bytes 24-39 hold the unit attitude
# quaternion (float32 LE x, w, y, z, the same offsets as the 50-byte push); bytes 40-48
# are zero in all three frames and nothing reads them.
